plugins.description: Cargo is go-to-market infrastructure for AI agents. These 19 skills let your agent build B2B lead and account lists, find and verify work emails, enrich companies and contacts from 50+ licensed data providers, score leads, sync your CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio and 140+ other tools), and watch buying signals like job changes, funding and hiring. Any of it can run as a scheduled workflow. New accounts get 100 free credits for their first 30 days, no card needed.
